suggestions.title: Toy Story
suggestions.description: A cowboy doll is threatened by the arrival of a new space ranger action figure in a child's bedroom. Pixar's landmark debut feature — the first fully computer-animated movie ever made — is a warm, hilarious, endlessly rewatchable buddy comedy about jealousy, loyalty, and friendship. Woody and Buzz Lightyear's journey turned a studio into a legend and redefined animation for a generation.

suggestions.title: Catch Me If You Can
suggestions.description: A teenage con artist impersonates a pilot, doctor, and lawyer while an FBI agent pursues him across the globe. Steven Spielberg's slick, stylish true story of Frank Abagnale Jr. is equal parts caper and character study — DiCaprio's charm offensive and Hanks' dogged agent make for one of the most effortlessly entertaining cat-and-mouse games in cinema.

suggestions.title: Blade Runner 2049
suggestions.description: A new blade runner unearths a long-buried secret that could destabilize society, leading him to find former blade runner Rick Deckard. Denis Villeneuve's awe-inspiring sequel honors Ridley Scott's original while forging its own identity — a meditative, breathtakingly beautiful neon-noir existential thriller anchored by Ryan Gosling and a towering score by Hans Zimmer.
